source_full_text: Who had had nothing to eat for two days and was very hungry. The door of the pit was hardly closed when the bear rushed at the shepherd but when it saw his eyes it was so frightened that it was ready to eat itself. It shrank away into a corner and gazed at him from there, and, in spite of being so famished, did not dare to touch him,
